520:t_3:18.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Then the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and the $$クォーター$$ have grasped $$アマルガム$$'s ultimate objective?」

520:t_3:19.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We don't know the details either. The transmission from Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ only told us that an emergency has occurred and where to rendezvous.」

520:t_3:20.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We'll descend into the atmosphere as well and hurry to the rendezvous point.」

520:t_3:21.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We'll have her explain the details of the situation in person once you get there.」

520:t_3:22.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「On our end, we've established that the mysterious robot army is the work of $$ガイゾック$$, and we've confirmed the revival of $$皇帝ズール$$, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, and $$ハーデス$$ of $$ミケーネ$$.」

520:t_3:23.en:
$$ブライト$$
「At a time like this...」

520:t_3:24.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「But we have defended Japan, and $$トライダー$$, $$ダイ・ガード$$, $$ダイターン３$$, $$ゴッドマーズ$$, $$鉄人２８号#robot$$...」

520:t_3:25.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...$$マジンガーＺ$$, $$真ゲッター$$ Robo, and $$ダンクーガノヴァマックスゴッド$$ have all been powered up.」

520:t_3:26.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「In addition, the $$くろがね五人衆$$ and Prince $$グーラ$$ have joined us to lend us their help.」

520:t_3:27.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That's a substantial increase in strength.」

520:t_3:28.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$ダンクーガノヴァ$$ and $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$, $$真ゲッター１$$ and $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, and the three Invincible Robots can use combination attacks now too.」

520:t_3:29.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「But if the world is destroyed, even this power will mean nothing...」

520:t_3:30.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Still, destroying the world... I can't read the intent behind it at all.」

520:t_3:31.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All the answers lie where we are headed.」

520:t_3:32.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The rendezvous point being off $$相模湾$$ means...」

520:t_3:33.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Most likely, the site of the final battle with $$アマルガム$$ will be the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$.」

520:t_3:34.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We hope you can join us as soon as possible.」

520:t_3:35.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...We have to hurry, then.」

520:t_3:36.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then, the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$...」

520:t_3:37.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Can I leave it to you, Captain $$ジンネマン$$?」

520:t_3:39.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Before, you pointed out to me, Captain, that there are things I can't see precisely because I'm one of the Federation.」

520:t_3:40.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It's rude of me, but I looked into your history, Captain, and into what happened after the $$一年戦争$$ as well.」

520:t_3:42.en:
$$ブライト$$
「An apology doesn't settle the matter, but allow me to apologize as a soldier of the $$地球連邦軍$$.」

520:t_3:44.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I have a family too... I can understand a little of your regret, Captain.」

520:t_3:45.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Because you are a man who overcame that, Captain, I believe you are worthy of trust.」

520:t_3:46.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I am... a weak man. I may betray you all again...」

520:t_3:47.en:
$$ブライト$$
「No matter how weak a person is, there is a line they can hold at. I see that you can keep to yours now, Captain.」

520:t_3:48.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Can I entrust the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ to you?」

520:t_3:49.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I swear it on my late wife and daughter.」

520:t_3:52.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Tell Miss $$スメラギ$$ as well. $c will head for Earth as quickly as possible.」

520:t_3:53.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Whatever $$アマルガム$$'s goal may be, we can't allow the destruction of the world.」

520:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When $$フロンタル$$ spoke of his own plan, why did he take off his mask?」

520:t_10:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「...A mask signifies lies and falsehood. He probably meant to speak his true intentions, in his own way.」

520:t_10:8.en:
$$シャア$$
「But in the end, it only confirmed that we are beings who can never coexist.」

520:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I hear that inside $$フロンタル$$ there is the consciousness of the Mr. $$シャア$$ of a parallel world, though...」

520:t_10:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「Even the same person from a parallel world is a stranger.」

520:t_10:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「But setting aside where his methods and sense of mission come from, I was able to confirm that he, too, had a will that worries about where the world is headed.」

520:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That very thing must be the mark of $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

520:t_10:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「With only a slight difference, he and I might have become comrades who understood each other from the bottom of our hearts...」

520:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And so, to commemorate your return, how about one?」

520:t_10:16.en:
$$シャア$$
「I should have already completed the ritual. Spare me.」

520:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then I shall welcome Mr. $$シャア$$...! Let's work hard again today... business, business!」

520:t_10:18.en:
$$シャア$$
(Did $$ハマーン$$ go through this too while I was gone...?)

521:t_000:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「To think we could pull $$ザフト$$ away from $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and cut their strength by nearly half.」

521:t_000:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Returning with better results than expected... This is a true triumphal return.」

521:t_000:2.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I think it's still too early to savor the victory, though...」

521:t_000:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「I know that myself. But a little savoring is all right, isn't it?」

521:t_000:4.en:
$$レイアム$$
「...You're right. The crew are worn out from one battle after another, so I hope we can catch our breath during this stay.」

521:t_000:5.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「The guide beacon from the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ has arrived.」

521:t_000:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「Good...! Following the $$ラー・カイラム$$, we'll enter port as well.」

521:t_001:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「All the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ who had occupied the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ have deployed!」

521:t_001:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Let's go! We take down $$フル・フロンタル$$ here!」

521:t_003:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「Time to settle this, $$フロンタル$$!」

521:t_003:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even I have come to understand that walking the same path as you is impossible.」

521:t_003:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「And I realized something. That I find you just as unpleasant as you find me.」

521:t_003:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So this world has no need for two of the same man, is that it?」

521:t_004:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You are not the only one who wants to settle things with that man.」

521:t_004:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't apologize. Otherwise I'll want to make you the only villain again.」

521:t_004:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「First, we take down $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

521:t_005:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Our target is $$フロンタル$$'s $$シナンジュ$$! Take it down, and the battle is won!」

521:t_005:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You can do it, can't you, $$バナージ$$?」

521:t_005:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I rejected the world that man envisions. So I'll show I can do it!」

521:t_005:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Come, $$シャア$$, $$アムロ$$, $$ハマーン$$... and $$バナージ$$.」

521:t_005:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The world is hurrying toward its end. Let us begin the prelude to it.」
